name: convention-directory-moved-by-a-literal
description: A configuration property a row reads moves the directory its entry globs name when the file's default export sets it to a string literal, so the root file of the moved directory is a root and the one in the default directory is reported as a file nothing imports. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
